SPAM.suspect: This message looks suspicious. Be careful with its links and attachments.
SPAM.spam: This message was marked as spam.

ALREADY_DECIDED: Already decided in {{ source }}: this is the answer it holds.

NOTIFICATIONS.NO_EMPLOYEE: Notifications are addressed to employees; this account has no employee profile.
NOTIFICATIONS.ERROR: The notifications could not be loaded.

SETTINGS.UNAVAILABLE: Email for the Inbox is not switched on for this installation.

ERRORS.LOAD: The email settings could not be loaded.
ERRORS.SAVE: That could not be saved. Try again.

PROVIDERS.TITLE: Inbox providers
PROVIDERS.SUBTITLE: Email providers this server can receive and send mail through, and your accounts with them.
PROVIDERS.NO_PROVIDERS: No email provider is loaded on this server.
PROVIDERS.NO_ACCOUNTS: No accounts yet. Platform addresses need none; a custom domain receives through one.
PROVIDERS.NAME: Name
PROVIDERS.DEFAULT_OUTBOUND: Send this scope's outbound mail through this account
PROVIDERS.DEFAULT_OUTBOUND_HINT: Replies from the Inbox and other mail of the scope use it instead of SMTP.
PROVIDERS.TENANT_READ_ONLY: This account is for all organizations: changing it needs the permission to edit all organizations.
PROVIDERS.NOT_LOADED: This provider is not loaded on this server: the account receives and sends nothing.
PROVIDERS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this account? Nothing is received or sent through it any more.
PROVIDERS.WEBHOOK_HINT: Paste this URL into the provider's inbound webhook settings.
PROVIDERS.WEBHOOK_SHOWN_ONCE: This provider's webhook URL carries a credential: it was shown once, when the account was created. Edit the account and generate a new credential to see a new URL.

FORM.SECRET_KEEP: Leave empty to keep the stored value; type to replace it
FORM.GENERATED_ON_CREATE: Generated by the server when the account is saved, and shown once.
FORM.ROTATE: Generate a new one when saved (the current one stops working)

ERRORS.UNSUPPORTED: This field has a type the form does not support.

ONE_TIME.TITLE: Shown once
ONE_TIME.WARNING: Copy these values now: they cannot be shown again. Losing one means generating a new one.
ONE_TIME.PROVIDER_HINT: Paste them into the provider's settings.
ONE_TIME.MAILBOX_HINT: Give it to the relay that delivers this mailbox's mail.

KIND_HINT.PLATFORM: An address on this server's mail domain, allocated for the owner: nothing to set up.
KIND_HINT.CUSTOM_DOMAIN: An address on your own domain: prove the domain with a DNS record and receive through a provider account.
KIND_HINT.FORWARDING: A platform address you forward an existing mailbox to: no DNS change.

DOMAIN_STATUS_HINT.PENDING: Mail to this address is not accepted until the TXT record below is found. DNS changes can take a while to spread.
DOMAIN_STATUS_HINT.VERIFIED: The domain is proven: mail is accepted.
DOMAIN_STATUS_HINT.FAILED: The domain was verified, but its TXT record is gone: mail is no longer accepted. Put the record back.

MAILBOXES.TITLE: Inbox mailboxes
MAILBOXES.SUBTITLE: The addresses your organization receives mail at: shared mailboxes and each employee's own.
MAILBOXES.ACCOUNT_MISSING: None (the account was removed or disabled)
MAILBOXES.NO_RECEIVING_ACCOUNT: No provider account that receives mail yet: add one in Settings → Inbox providers first.
MAILBOXES.ADDRESS_PREVIEW: The address will be {{ name }}.<organization>@{{ domain }}; left empty, the name part comes from the owner.
MAILBOXES.ALLOWLIST_HINT: Empty: mail from any sender that passes the checks is accepted.
MAILBOXES.MAKE_DEFAULT_ON_CREATE: Make it the owner's default mailbox
MAILBOXES.LIST_UNAVAILABLE: This list could not be loaded (it needs the permission to view it).
MAILBOXES.AGENT: Hand the mail to an Ever Works agent
MAILBOXES.AGENT_HINT: Every message this mailbox receives is passed to the agent, which works on it in Ever Works.
MAILBOXES.AGENTS_UNAVAILABLE: The agents could not be listed.
MAILBOXES.NO_AGENTS: No Ever Works agent in this organization: connect Ever Works in Integrations first.
MAILBOXES.AGENT_MIRROR_HINT: To also see the agents' own mail in the Inbox, switch on "Agent email" on Integrations → Ever Works → Entities and directions.
MAILBOXES.PLATFORM_DOMAIN: Platform addresses are allocated on {{ domain }}.
MAILBOXES.NO_PLATFORM_DOMAIN: This server has no platform mail domain (GAUZY_INBOX_DOMAIN): only custom-domain mailboxes can be added.
MAILBOXES.AUTO_PROVISION: Create a mailbox for every new employee
MAILBOXES.PROVISION_EMPLOYEES: Create the missing employee mailboxes now
MAILBOXES.AUTO_PROVISION_HINT: Agent employees never get a mailbox automatically.
MAILBOXES.ROTATE_CONFIRM: Generate a new relay secret? The current one stops working at once.
MAILBOXES.DOMAIN_NOT_VERIFIED: The TXT record was not found yet.
MAILBOXES.MX_HINT: Point the domain's MX records at the inbound servers of {{ account }} (see its documentation).
MAILBOXES.DNS_UNAVAILABLE: The DNS record could not be read: try "Check DNS now".
MAILBOXES.FORWARD_FROM_TO: Forward the mail of {{ from }} to {{ to }}.
MAILBOXES.FORWARD_TO: Forward the mail you want in the Inbox to {{ to }}.

ERRORS.LOCAL_PART: Letters, digits, dashes and dots only (at most 64).
ERRORS.DOMAIN: Enter a domain such as example.test.
ERRORS.RESERVED_DOMAIN: That domain belongs to the platform.
ERRORS.ALLOWLIST: {{ entry }} is neither an address nor an @domain.
ERRORS.NO_PLATFORM_DOMAIN: This server has no platform mail domain: choose a custom domain.

MEMBERS.TITLE: Members of {{ address }}
MEMBERS.HINT: Members receive the mail; managers also release held mail and read the raw message. Without members, a team mailbox reaches the team and an organization mailbox the users who manage mailboxes.
MEMBERS.LOAD_ERROR: The members could not be loaded.
MEMBERS.USERS_FORBIDDEN: The organization's users cannot be listed with your permissions.

MY_MAILBOX.TITLE: My mailbox
MY_MAILBOX.SUBTITLE: The addresses whose mail reaches your Inbox.
MY_MAILBOX.FORBIDDEN: Your account cannot see the Inbox mailboxes.
MY_MAILBOX.ERROR: Your mailboxes could not be loaded.
MY_MAILBOX.EMPTY: You have no mailbox yet. An administrator can create one in Settings → Inbox mailboxes.

NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.TITLE: Notifications
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: What reaches you, and how: in your inbox always, by email at once or in a daily digest.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.NO_EMPLOYEE: Notifications belong to your employee profile in an organization, and this account has none here.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.FORBIDDEN: These settings are not yours to read.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.LOAD_ERROR: Your notification settings could not load.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.SAVE_FAILED: That setting was not saved. Try again.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.KINDS_HINT: Turning a kind off stops its emails and browser notifications; its notifications still reach your bell and your Inbox. The select beside a kind is how its email goes out.

ASSIGNMENT.TITLE: Assignments
ASSIGNMENT.TEXT: Someone assigns a task to you.

MENTION.TITLE: Mentions
MENTION.TEXT: Someone writes @ and your name in a comment.

COMMENT.TITLE: Comments
COMMENT.TEXT: Someone comments on a task you follow.

INVITATION.TITLE: Invitations
INVITATION.TEXT: Someone invites you to a team.

MESSAGE.TITLE: Messages
MESSAGE.TEXT: Someone sends you a direct message.

PAYMENT.TITLE: Payments
PAYMENT.TEXT: A payment is recorded for you.

NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.EMAIL_HINT: How a kind reaches you by email unless its own select says otherwise.

EMAIL_NOTICE.OFF: This server sends no notification emails. Your choices are kept and apply once it does.
EMAIL_NOTICE.UNAVAILABLE: No mail server answers for this organization right now, so notification emails cannot go out. Your choices are kept.

NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.DEFAULT_TEXT: At once, in the daily digest, or never.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.QUIET_TEXT: No email between these times ({{timeZone}}); it waits until the window ends.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.DIGEST_TEXT: One email a day, at this hour, with the entries set to the digest.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.PUSH_HINT: A notification on this device when something new reaches your inbox, even when the app is not open.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.PUSH_FAILED: Browser notifications could not be changed. Try again.
NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS.PUSH_RETRY_FAILED: This browser's notifications still could not be confirmed. Try again later, or switch notifications off.

PUSH_STATE.on: This browser shows your new inbox entries.
PUSH_STATE.sync-failed: This browser's notifications could not be confirmed for your account: your new entries may not arrive here, or an earlier sign-in's still could. Try again, or switch notifications off.
PUSH_STATE.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site: allow them in your browser settings, then switch this on.
